title: Oversized sash / insufficient manufacturing clearance
evidence: Meeting sightline is below the FenIQ working target of 6 mm.
Available hinge adjustment has been exhausted.
Frame geometry has been checked and reported acceptable.
Low aluminium threshold recorded; clearance sensitivity should be checked.
Sash dimensions have been independently verified.
recommendation: Compare verified sash and frame dimensions against the approved manufacturing specification. If geometry is acceptable and adjustment is exhausted, escalate for an engineer-approved remake decision.
repair_steps: Confirm frame level, square and plumb
rule_note: FenIQ working rules are decision-support logic and are not manufacturer specifications unless separately verified.
